items.title: Trump eyes busy week of meetings as UN General Assembly gathers
items.title_zh: 联大周：特朗普将晤泽连斯基、伯纳姆、高市早苗与海合会
items.summary_zh: 海峡时报9月21日：特朗普预计21日下午抵纽约、晚间川普大厦活动，22日上午联大演讲；将晤英国首相安迪·伯纳姆、日本首相高市早苗、海合会领导人，并首次当面见委内瑞拉临时总统德尔西·罗德里格斯；21日还将在格雷西大厦会见纽约市长马姆达尼。沃尔特兹称演讲将强调“伊朗永不得核武”。

quotes.author: Mike Waltz / Straits Times
quotes.en: The president will highlight how he has and his administration have confronted complex problems head-on around the world. He will touch on the importance of ensuring that Iran never has a nuclear weapon.
quotes.zh: 总统将强调他与政府如何正面应对全球复杂问题。他会谈到确保伊朗永不得核武的重要性。

items.title: The Effect of CRTs on Pixel Art
items.summary_zh: Datagubbe 讨论 CRT 扫描线与像素艺术的关系；评论主张现代像素画是为高 DPI LED 而生的独立审美，并吐槽多数游戏 CRT 滤镜过重，唯独夸 Cyber Shadow。

quotes.author: fasterik
quotes.en: I like to think of modern pixel art as its own aesthetic and art form. It's designed to be viewed on high DPI LED screens, and that's fine. I don't think it should be judged by how it looked on CRTs.
quotes.zh: 我更愿意把现代像素画看成独立审美与艺术形式。它本就是为高 DPI LED 屏设计的，不应再用 CRT 观感来评判。

quotes.author: TulliusCicero
quotes.en: Related, I usually hate CRT filters in game, the scan lines usually look too strong (and often the image is darkened inappropriately), but I really liked the one in Cyber Shadow.
quotes.zh: 相关地，我通常讨厌游戏里的 CRT 滤镜——扫描线太重、画面还常被不当地压暗——但我很喜欢 Cyber Shadow 里的那一版。

items.title: World leaders return to UN amid wars in Middle East and Ukraine
items.title_zh: 联大开幕：习跳过纽约改赴华府会特朗普，AI成议程
items.summary_zh: 路透9月20日：近130位国家元首齐聚纽约；习近平将跳过联大改周四在华盛顿与特朗普一对一会谈。古特雷斯称AI将成重大议题并吁设共同护栏，特朗普则斥AI风险论为“骗局”。佩泽希齐扬周三演讲、内塔尼亚胡周四演讲；阿巴斯再被拒签、联大已表决允许其视频出席。

quotes.author: Antonio Guterres / Reuters
quotes.en: common guardrails in order to avoid this race to the bottom that could lead one day to a gigantic disaster at the global level.
quotes.zh: （需要）共同护栏，以免这场逐底竞赛有朝一日酿成全球级巨大灾难。

items.title: So I have a weatherman, which also tells me the news
items.title_zh: 我有个天气预报员，顺带播新闻
items.summary_zh: Dexteroot 自制会播报天气与新闻的装置；评论关心工期，并警告室内湿度 82% 过高有霉菌风险，建议把 DHT 换成 Sensirion SHT40/41。

quotes.author: schiffern
quotes.en: Cool! How long did the project take, would you say? BTW 82% indoor humidity is really high; usually over 60% humidity and you risk mold and mildew growth in localized moisture hotspots.
quotes.zh: 酷！这个项目大概花了多久？另外室内湿度 82% 真的很高；通常超过 60% 就有局部霉菌风险。

quotes.author: otherme123
quotes.en: If you are going to build this, if possible switch the DHT for a Sensirion SHT40, 41 or a similar one. They are way better.
quotes.zh: 如果你要自己做，尽量把 DHT 换成 Sensirion SHT40/41 或同类——好太多了。

items.title: AI dominance, tariffs, Middle East: Washington braces for 'diplomatic super week'
items.title_zh: 华盛顿“外交超级周”：习特会盯AI、釜山关税休战与中东
items.summary_zh: 韩国先驱报9月20日：美方称习特华盛顿峰会将把AI与“釜山休战”框架置于议程顶端；特朗普拟周三亲赴安德鲁斯基地接机，周四白宫欢迎仪式与国宴，黄仁勋、奥特曼、库克、马斯克、贝索斯、戴尔等科技CEO受邀。联大侧则排英国、日本、海合会与伊朗战争相关磋商。

quotes.author: Herald Business
quotes.en: Trump plans to travel personally to Joint Base Andrews near Washington to greet Xi on the tarmac on Wednesday, the day Xi arrives for his US visit.
quotes.zh: 特朗普计划周三亲自前往华盛顿附近的安德鲁斯联合基地，在停机坪迎接抵达访美的习近平。

items.title: Go-based Robotics Framework built around NATS.io
items.title_zh: 围绕 NATS.io 的 Go 机器人框架
items.summary_zh: Emerging Robotics 开源基于 Go 与 NATS 的机器人框架 Gorai；评论嫌 README 过长，并吐槽“Claude 写的说明需要人类再过一遍去虚词”。

quotes.en: IMHO the Readme is too verbose, it contains a lot of information that should be somewhere else than a landing page.
quotes.zh: 依我看 README 太啰嗦了，很多信息不该堆在落地页。

quotes.author: luckydata
quotes.en: the readme written by Claude is annoying. At least it explains what the project does but imho the writing needs a healthy human pass to remove all the bullshit phrasing.
quotes.zh: Claude 写的 README 很烦人。至少解释了项目做什么，但写法需要人类好好过一遍，去掉那些虚夸措辞。

items.title: France vows response after Iran closes language centre in Tehran
items.title_zh: 伊朗查封德黑兰法语中心，法国外交部称将召见大使反制
items.summary_zh: 路透9月20日：伊朗依德黑兰检察官命令查封隶属法国使馆的法语语言中心，指其无证运营并从事危害文化与国家安全活动；法国外交部发言人称继七月两名馆员遇袭后“不可接受”，将召见伊朗大使并采取适当措施。阿拉格齐与巴罗预计周二联大场边会面。

quotes.author: Pascal Confavreux / French Foreign Ministry
quotes.en: This new attack against France's cultural presence in Iran, following the assault on two staff members of the French embassy last July, is unjustifiable and unacceptable.
quotes.zh: 继今年七月法国使馆两名工作人员遇袭之后，这次对法国在伊朗文化存在的新攻击既无理亦不可接受。

items.title: Arrow heads at Obi-Rakhmat (Uzbekistan) 80K years ago?
items.title_zh: 乌兹别克斯坦 Obi-Rakhmat：8万年前的箭头？
items.summary_zh: PLOS One 论文讨论中亚遗址石器是否可能是箭头，时间点或比预期早约 2.5 万年；评论概括“太小而不能当矛头的刃装在杆上”，并吐槽实验用现代复合弓射完整尸体的方法学细节。

quotes.author: dr_dshiv
quotes.en: Short story: stones were used to make "arrow-heads" (blades on sticks too small for spears) 25k years earlier than expected.
quotes.zh: 一句话：用石头做“箭头”（装在杆上、小到不像矛头的刃）的时间，可能比预期早约 2.5 万年。

quotes.author: khalic
quotes.en: being shot with a modern laminated bow (36 lbs) on a complete uneviscerated carcass of a small ungulate hung in anatomical position in order to start documenting impact breakage
quotes.zh: 用现代层压弓（36磅）射击悬挂成解剖姿势、未经开膛的小型有蹄类完整尸体，以便开始记录撞击断裂。

items.title: Iran warns US and its allies against new attack, threatens retaliation
items.title_zh: 伊朗警告美及其盟友勿发动新攻击，扬言持续报复
items.summary_zh: 印度时报9月21日：伊朗军方中央指挥部周日警告，美及其盟友任何重大新攻击将触发对美军基地与利益的持续报复，地区盟友将被视作战方；并称掌握有关准备中的行动情报。特朗普同日警告伊朗若不达成协议将面临严重后果，并称“非常大的事情”可能发生。警告正值胡塞宣称打击利雅得与延布之际。

quotes.author: Iran military central command / Times of India
quotes.en: any new attack would be met with retaliation against US bases and interests, while Washington's regional allies would be considered parties to the conflict.
quotes.zh: 任何新攻击都将遭到对美军基地与利益的报复，同时华盛顿的地区盟友将被视作冲突当事方。

items.title: I stopped drinking the AI Kool-Aid
items.title_zh: 我不再喝 AI 的迷魂汤
items.summary_zh: Joshtronic 写退出 AI 狂热的心路；评论引用“你不愿写我就不愿读”来嘲讽代理互发邮件，并称这是少见写得舒服的反 AI 随笔。

quotes.author: variety8675
quotes.en: Using AI agents to email each other is just a reflection of "If you're not going to bother to write it, I'm not going to read it"
quotes.zh: 让 AI 代理互相发邮件，不过是在复述那句：“你都不肯认真写，我凭什么认真读。”

quotes.author: cpoile
quotes.en: One of the nicer blogs I've read on the subject, thanks Josh.
quotes.zh: 这是我读过的、写得比较舒服的一篇同题博客，谢谢 Josh。
